edits.label: Own the genuine raw producer event before deliberate pending consumption; return its actual invocation leave result

diagnosis: The raw probe created an actual fatal event, deliberately took and freed the pending reason, then returned successful undefined. Its caller could continue guest work before an enclosing native owner eventually restored that event. A producer-local NativeInvocation owns the genuine event at the producer and returns the selected abrupt result before the guest caller continues. Retained diagnostic allocation DATA is not used as authority.
